title: MADSNet: A Multi-Scale Axial-Attentive Dense Spiking Network for Spike Camera Image Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.12980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spike cameras encode dynamic scenes into high-temporal-resolution binary spike streams for efficient high-speed vision. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process such signals with sparse and accumulate-only computation, existing SNN-based reconstruction methods are typically shallow and still lag behind ANN-based models in reconstruction fidelity. This paper proposes MADSNet, a Multi-scale Axial-attentive Dense Spiking Network for spike camera image reconstruction. MADSNet adopts a hierarchical spiking encoder--decoder, where a multi-scale spike stem extracts early features, axial spike attention captures long-range dependencies, a dense spiking bottleneck enhances feature reuse, and a spike-to-continuous decoder reconstructs continuous intensity images from spike-domain representations. Experiments on gray-scale and color spike reconstruction show that MADSNet outperforms SSIR by 4.3 dB PSNR and Spk2ImgNet by 1.94 dB on SRED

translated_title: MADSNet：一种用于脉冲相机图像重建的多尺度轴向注意力密集脉冲网络
translated_abstract: 脉冲相机将动态场景编码为高时间分辨率的二值脉冲流，以实现高效的高速视觉处理。尽管脉冲神经网络（SNN）能够以稀疏且仅累加的计算方式处理这类信号，但现有的基于SNN的重建方法通常网络结构较浅，在重建保真度上仍落后于基于人工神经网络（ANN）的模型。本文提出了MADSNet，一种用于脉冲相机图像重建的多尺度轴向注意力密集脉冲网络。MADSNet采用分层脉冲编码器-解码器结构，其中多尺度脉冲干模块提取早期特征，轴向脉冲注意力捕获长程依赖关系，密集脉冲瓶颈层增强特征复用，脉冲到连续的解码器则从脉冲域表示中重建连续的强度图像。在灰度和彩色脉冲重建实验中，MADSNet在SRED数据集上比SSIR高出4.3 dB PSNR，比Spk2ImgNet高出1.94 dB。
tldr: 提出了一种多尺度轴向注意力密集脉冲网络MADSNet，通过分层脉冲编码器-解码器结构实现高质量脉冲相机图像重建，在SRED数据集上显著超越现有SNN重建方法。
en_tdlr: MADSNet, a multi-scale axial-attentive dense spiking network with a hierarchical spiking encoder-decoder, achieves superior spike camera image reconstruction, outperforming SSIR by 4.3 dB PSNR and Spk2ImgNet by 1.94 dB on SRED.
